expected: Fresh cancel line Qty=-1, asset list=net=15000 no discount: NetUnitPrice=15000, TotalPrice=NetUnitPrice x -1 = -15000, quote header Subtotal/TotalPrice roll up -15000 credit.
actual: Force-reprice ERRORS at StampBaseFilter#1 (SF-Pricing-00006 / SF-BRE-00004). Both fresh cancel QLIs stay NetUnitPrice=null, TotalPrice=0, Subtotal=0 (NOT -15000). Quote headers CalculationStatus=PriceCalculationFailed. Reproduced on 2 independent fresh quotes.
defectStep: StampBaseFilter (parent StampContributorBasePreDiscount): criterion #5 NetUnitPrice GreaterThan 0 is not null-safe; condition logic (1 OR 2) AND 3 AND 4 AND 5 has no IsNull guard on NetUnitPrice. A fresh cancel line has NetUnitPrice=null so the rules engine cannot evaluate GreaterThan -> SF-BRE-00004, aborting the whole reprice before CancelLineCreditPosthook can seed the credit.
proposedFix: NOT applied. Null-guard StampBaseFilter so cancel lines pass: change crit #5 to (NetUnitPrice IsNull OR NetUnitPrice > 0), or seed NetUnitPrice from CancelNetUnitPrice__c in an early V21 ListGroup BEFORE StampBaseFilter so it is non-null at that step. Posthook alone cannot bootstrap a fresh line because the reprice errors out first.
defect_provenance: SC-3441 - cancellation TotalPrice=0; posthook fix (2026-06-27) only credits lines whose NetUnitPrice is already non-null; durability/bootstrap gap on a fresh cancel line re-manifests on V21.
proc_mechanism: CancelNetUnitPrice__c seed + CancelLineCreditPosthook writing QLI field-API attrs (NetUnitPrice/TotalPrice/Subtotal/NetTotalPrice/TotalLineAmount).
notes: K-08 derived-cancel quote 0Q0WC000003FbLh0AK got -71 and prior 0Q0WC000003EQtl0AG got -15000 ONLY because their NetUnitPrice was already non-null (71 / 15000) so they cleared StampBaseFilter.
